name: Shaad Qureshi
title: Gameplay/Engine Programmer
summary: I'm a game developer with a computer science background, and most of my work is building core gameplay mechanics in Unity and Unreal Engine. I want to make worlds that pull players in and get other people excited to make games of their own.
about: I'm a Computer Science student with a background in AI, but I've always been a game developer at heart. It started with a Nintendo Wii when I was a kid, and I've loved games with their own worlds and stories ever since. Most of what I build is core gameplay, in C# for Unity and Blueprints for Unreal Engine. Freelancing has had me working with a lot of designers and figuring out how to make their more complicated ideas actually work in the engine. I want to work on games people love at a big studio, and one day make my own that gets the next generation of players hooked.

top3.title: Unity
top3.subTitle: I build gameplay mechanics and systems in C#, and I try to keep the code clean and reusable, from player controls to UI.

top3.title: Unreal Engine
top3.subTitle: I build interactive environments and gameplay events. Most of my systems and logic live in Blueprints, and I switch to C++ when something needs to run fast.

top3.title: Blender
top3.subTitle: I make optimized 3D assets for my own games and handle the whole process myself, from hard-surface modeling and UV mapping to PBR texturing.

projects.title: Counting Sheep
projects.desc: A 3D arcade platformer made solo in 96 hours for the GMTK Game Jam 2026. You guide a floaty sheep across cloud-cube numerals that crumble and reform under you as a sleeper counts down to sleep.

projects.title: Harvest Rush
projects.desc: A farming game for one player or two on the same couch. You till, plant, and water crops, then rush the harvest onto a delivery truck before it leaves, while pests steal produce and fires spread across the field.

projects.title: Tic-Tac-Gone
projects.desc: A 3D take on tic-tac-toe for the browser where each player can only keep three pieces on the board, and placing a fourth removes their oldest. Built with Three.js, with local two-player and a computer opponent on three difficulty levels.

projects.title: Pokémon Bushido
projects.desc: A Pokémon fangame set in a region inspired by feudal Japan, where you train with your Pokémon to become a Kenshi and fight the Akui Clan and their Shadow Pokémon.

projects.title: Pokémon Splice
projects.desc: A Pokémon fangame where you play a research assistant helping Professor Cypress study new Pokémon forms, with a starter that can change its type and a story that branches on which team you join.

projects.title: CareerPath AI
projects.desc: An AI career counselor I built in 3 days as an experiment in coding with Gemini 3 Pro. It suggests careers that fit your profile, maps out how to get into each one, and generates 'day in the life' images of the job.

projects.title: SQLift
projects.desc: A full-stack workout tracker built around a relational database. You plan workouts, log live sessions set by set, track body measurements and progress over time, and compete on global and friends-only leaderboards.

projects.title: NanoRewind 4K
projects.desc: A web app that uses Google Gemini to restore old, scratched and faded family photos. It runs on React and Vercel serverless functions, with Supabase handling accounts, credits and a private photo album.

projects.title: Artist Portfolio
projects.desc: A portfolio website for Emaad, an artist in my family, built with React and Vite and hosted free on GitHub Pages. Emaad adds and edits pieces through a Decap CMS dashboard without writing any code.

projects.title: HOMI - Helpful Online Mentor Interface
projects.desc: A study assistant for IT students built on a fine-tuned LLM. It answers questions, writes study material, generates practice tests, and tracks attendance and assignments.

projects.title: Findly - Lost and Found Application
projects.desc: An Android app with a Firebase backend where people post lost or found items and chat with each other to get them back to their owners.
